text: 对你意志的攻击骤然停止。你听见老妇人倒吸一口气，随后她瘫倒在你身后的地上。吟唱声止息，营地一片寂静。众人散开，聚到老妇人身边。
基瓦内玛人显得十分慌乱，彼此商议了几分钟，随后抬起昏迷的女王离开。他们留下你和学生们，仍被绑在原地。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 256
text: Abruptly, the attack upon your will ceases. You hear the hag gasp, and she collapses on the earth behind you. The chanting stops. A hush spreads through the camp. They break from the ring and gather over the old woman.
In some distress, the Keywanema confer. After a few minutes, they gather up their unconscious queen and carry her away. They leave you and the students still bound.
